entries: Sunrise is at 6:56 AM with 11 h 15 m of daylight. Overnight at North Island, no rain; air 65–74 °F (18–23 °C) and humidity 61–90%, 65 °F (18 °C) and 65% at 5:52 AM. Water 73 °F (23.0 °C) at CDIP 191.

CDIP 191 at 5:00 AM: 15.4 s from S 190°, 4.1 ft (1.24 m); 14.3 s from W 272°, 2.9 ft (0.87 m). At 11:00 AM yesterday: 16.7 s from S 191°, 4.8 ft (1.48 m). Breaking at 5:00 AM, against 11:00 AM yesterday: North 5.1 ft (1.54 m), little change; Center 4.0 ft (1.21 m), filling from 3.0 ft (0.91 m); South 3.7 ft (1.14 m), little change. North leads, as it did. Arriving at all three breaks: the 15.8 s train from the Southern Ocean, sent about Oct 9 from about 6,500 mi (10,000 km) away, about 14 s by 5:00 PM.

The tide is pushing to 5.1 ft (1.55 m) at 6:53 AM then dropping to 4.4 ft (1.33 m) at 11:30 AM. The previous PM low was 2.1 ft (0.65 m) at 11:26 PM yesterday and the PM high will be 5.5 ft (1.67 m) at 4:56 PM. The gauge is running 1.3 ft (0.38 m) over the harmonic prediction, over the last 3 days. Today's range is 1.1 ft (0.34 m), neap tides; springs around Oct 25. On the 2016 survey the tide moves where the waves break, not how big they are; this season's sandbars are not known.

NW 310° at 3 mph (3 kt) at 5:52 AM: light offshore at North; light cross-shore at Center and South. At this hour on the 28 days before: North light or variable on 10, offshore on 13; Center light or variable on 10, offshore on 12; South light or variable on 10, offshore on 13. Median 5 mph (4 kt).

Former hurricane [Simon](https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/archive/2026/SIMON_graphics.php): every fix NHC has logged or forecast is behind land from Point Loma South, so nothing it has sent reaches the breaks. Tropical Storm [Trudy](https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/archive/2026/TRUDY_graphics.php) {tropical storm symbol}: every fix NHC has logged or forecast is behind land from Point Loma South, so nothing it has sent reaches the breaks.
